title: Tetrametallic Ln(III) (Ln = Gd, Dy) phosphonate clusters: Spin cooler and single-molecule magnet

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear lanthanide phosphonate cluster with Ln ions at vertices of an irregular quadrilateral

synthesis.procedure: RPO3H2 (26.0 mg, 0.1 mmol) and Gd2 precursor [Gd2(O2CtBu)6(HO2CtBu)6] (114.9 mg, 0.075 mmol) were dissolved in CH2Cl2/CH3CN (16 mL, v/v = 1:1) and stirred at room temperature for 24 h. The resulting solid was filtered off and the filtrate was kept in a vial for ca. two weeks to obtain colorless crystals, which were collected by filtration.
synthesis.time: stirred 24 h; crystallization ca. two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution then filtrate crystallization in a vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solid filtered off; filtrate kept in a vial for ca. two weeks; colorless crystals collected by filtration

properties.summary: Gd4 shows weak antiferromagnetic Gd···Gd coupling and a magnetocaloric effect, with maximum magnetic entropy change −ΔSm = 23.10 J kg−1 K−1 at 2.5 K for ΔH = 7 T, slightly below the calculated maximum 25.62 J kg−1 K−1; discussed as a potential molecular spin cooler.

measurements.name: χMT (room temperature)
measurements.conditions: dc field 0.1 T; 2–300 K data; compared with 31.5 cm3 K mol−1 for four non-interacting Gd(III) (g = 2.0, S = 7/2)

measurements.name: χMT (2 K)
measurements.conditions: dc field 0.1 T; χMT nearly constant to 40 K then decreases

measurements.name: exchange coupling J1
measurements.conditions: MAGPACK fit of χMT; g = 2.0; Hamiltonian H = −2J1(S1S2 + S2S3) − 2J2(S1S4 + S2S4 + S3S4 + S1S3); J1 for μ-O-bridged Gd–Gd vectors; R = 6 × 10−5

measurements.name: exchange coupling J2
measurements.conditions: MAGPACK fit; J2 for O–P–O-bridged Gd–Gd vectors

measurements.name: magnetic entropy change −ΔSm (max)
measurements.conditions: from magnetization via Maxwell relation; 2.5 K, ΔH = 7 T (Fig. 3); calculated max 25.62 J kg−1 K−1

material_class.structural_family: isostructural tetranuclear lanthanide phosphonate cluster with Ln ions at vertices of an irregular quadrilateral

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by similar reactions of RPO3H2 with Dy2 precursor [Dy2(O2CtBu)6(HO2CtBu)6] under the conditions given for Gd4: ligand and dinuclear pivalate precursor dissolved in CH2Cl2/CH3CN (16 mL, v/v = 1:1), stirred at room temperature for 24 h, solid filtered off, and filtrate crystallized in a vial for ca. two weeks.

reagents.name: [Dy2(O2CtBu)6(HO2CtBu)6] (Dy2)
reagents.amount: analogous to Gd2 (114.9 mg, 0.075 mmol) in the shared procedure

synthesis.time: stirred 24 h; crystallization ca. two weeks (as for Gd4)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution then filtrate crystallization in a vial (same as Gd4)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: same as Gd4: filtration of solid, crystallization from filtrate

properties.summary: Dy4 shows χMT consistent with four Dy(III) ions and possible intramolecular antiferromagnetic coupling; ac susceptibility reveals two-step slow magnetic relaxation characteristic of an SMM (fast-relaxation barrier 12 K, slow-relaxation barrier 21 K).

measurements.name: χMT (room temperature)
measurements.conditions: compared with 56.6 cm3 K mol−1 for four non-interacting Dy(III) (6H15/2, gJ = 4/3, J = 15/2)

measurements.name: χMT (2 K)
measurements.conditions: decreases slowly to ~50 K then more rapidly to 2 K

measurements.name: magnetization M
measurements.conditions: 5 T; effective gz = 10.8 from powder saturation model with S = 1/2

measurements.name: effective energy barrier ΔE(1)/kB (fast relaxation)
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of ac data; τ0 = 3.26 × 10−6 s; two processes at 3.5–6 K, 1–1000 Hz

measurements.name: effective energy barrier ΔE(2)/kB (slow relaxation)
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit; τ0 ≈ 1.04 × 10−4 s; Cole–Cole α = 0.01–0.08 and αSR = 0.29–0.50
